score_boundary: No frozen website-experience scoring rubric was used. This supplement records representative observations without creating a UX score.

limitations: The candidate was tested locally and has not been released to production.
No support form was submitted and no external purchase was attempted.
Mobile overflow was directly checked for the homepage, product detail, and methodology page; remaining representative pages were not separately exercised at mobile size.
Analytics, user research, Core Web Vitals, and a complete WCAG audit were not available.

summary.verdict: The local candidate adds a coherent, readable knowledge layer and preserves the commerce path; production release, complete mobile coverage, and conversion readback remain pending.

dimensions.label: Visual and brand expression
dimensions.summary: Homepage and product screenshots retain the existing GearDrop typography, spacing, colors, and product emphasis.

dimensions.label: Information architecture
dimensions.summary: Entity, methodology, FAQ, guide, brand, and status links are discoverable, but the Support surface remains English-only.

dimensions.label: Interaction and conversion
dimensions.summary: Product purchase and support paths are visible; submission, external checkout, and analytics confirmation were intentionally not performed.

dimensions.label: Responsive and accessibility basics
dimensions.summary: Tested 390px pages had no horizontal overflow and exposed one H1; exhaustive mobile and WCAG coverage remains open.

findings.title: The new knowledge layer preserves the product-led visual system
findings.summary: Representative screenshots show consistent GearDrop type, spacing, color, and card treatment across discovery and product detail.
findings.business_impact: Consistency reduces the risk that informational pages feel detached from the shopping journey.
findings.recommendation: Keep the retained desktop and mobile screenshots as visual regression references when the knowledge layer changes.
findings.completion_test: Representative homepage and product screenshots show no brand-system regression at 1440px and 390px.

findings.title: The primary Chinese journey ends in an English-only Support surface
findings.summary: The local candidate exposes entity, method, FAQ, guide, brand, and status navigation in Chinese, while Support remains English-only.
findings.business_impact: Users arriving from Chinese discovery pages may lose confidence or abandon a data correction or privacy request.
findings.recommendation: Localize Support and its confirmation/error states for zh-CN while preserving an English route or language switch.
findings.completion_test: The zh-CN support path, validation messages, privacy link, and success state are independently verified without changing the English path.

findings.title: Conversion completion and attribution are not yet evidenced
findings.summary: Product and Support actions are visible, but no form submission, external checkout, event reconciliation, or CRM readback was performed.
findings.business_impact: A visible action can still fail or remain unmeasured after release, hiding qualified demand and support failures.
findings.recommendation: Run a production canary for Support and outbound retailer clicks, then reconcile analytics and backend receipts before declaring the journey healthy.
findings.completion_test: Approved canary actions produce the expected UI state, event payload, and backend or destination readback without duplicate side effects.

findings.title: Representative mobile pages pass overflow checks but coverage is incomplete
findings.summary: Homepage, product detail, and methodology had one H1 and no horizontal overflow at 390x844; guide, about, and Support were not separately exercised on mobile.
findings.business_impact: Uncovered page types can regress without being caught by the current manual sample.
findings.recommendation: Add automated mobile smoke checks for every public knowledge template and complete a keyboard and WCAG-focused review.
findings.completion_test: Every public template passes 390px overflow, heading, landmark, focus, and keyboard checks with retained evidence.
